scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n ibkr,api,vite -c yellow,blue,green "node scripts/start-ibkr-gateway.js" "tsx server.ts" "vite"
scripts.dev:py: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const py = fs.existsSync(path.join('.venv', 'bin', 'python')) ? path.join('.venv', 'bin', 'python') : fs.existsSync(path.join('.venv', 'Scripts', 'python.exe')) ? path.join('.venv', 'Scripts', 'python.exe') : 'python'; process.exit(spawnSync(py, ['-m', 'uvicorn', 'python_service.main:app', '--port', '8001', '--reload'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }).status || 0);"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.test:all: npm test && node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const py = fs.existsSync(path.join('.venv', 'bin', 'python')) ? path.join('.venv', 'bin', 'python') : fs.existsSync(path.join('.venv', 'Scripts', 'python.exe')) ? path.join('.venv', 'Scripts', 'python.exe') : 'python'; process.exit(spawnSync(py, ['-m', 'pytest', 'python_service/tests'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }).status || 0);"
